implementation.targetScope: match/parse APIs and all three search options used by navigation search. Modern Node 24, Bun and browser bundles; no IE11 compatibility build.

appContract.scope: Navigation suggestion filtering, ten-result cap, match/parse highlight parts; NavigationSearch is mounted by all three theme-layout toolbars. Application dependency cutover is separate.
appContract.verification: Unchanged app getSuggestions/renderSuggestion functions transpiled with Bun; React element output compared against upstream. Synthetic labels, no live app/UI or data writes.

changes: Zero runtime dependencies. Native Unicode decomposition plus a small independently specified non-decomposing Latin transliteration table replaces remove-accents. No upstream runtime implementation copied.
UTF-16 source boundaries preserve emoji and decomposed accent clusters. Wider Latin canonical decomposition support is deliberate; Greek accents remain distinct.
Invalid parse ranges are rejected instead of silently losing or duplicating text. Valid adjacent ranges retain separate parts.
Independent ASCII index search avoids per-query regular expressions; non-ASCII matching retains case-insensitive literal regex behavior.
